summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Enterprise Finance Management feature. Fixed critical bugs in backend (timedelta import) and frontend (JSX syntax error). All 7 finance API endpoints working correctly with proper 19% MwSt. calculation. Finance Dashboard UI fully functional with all components rendering correctly.

critical_bugs.issue: Missing 'timedelta' import causing 500 error on daily-trend endpoint
critical_bugs.line: Line 7: from datetime import datetime, timezone (missing timedelta)
critical_bugs.impact: Daily trend endpoint returned 500 Internal Server Error
critical_bugs.fix_applied: Added timedelta to imports: from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

critical_bugs.issue: JSX syntax error - Adjacent Route elements without proper wrapping
critical_bugs.line: Lines 247-263: Finance route inserted inside CustomerDetail route
critical_bugs.impact: Frontend compilation failed - entire app broken
critical_bugs.fix_applied: Separated CustomerDetail and Finance routes properly
